title: Library Book Return Flow
scenario: A Member returns a borrowed book to "1.0 Process Return". The process reads overdue fee rules from "D2 Policies", updates the loan record in "D1 Loans", and issues a return receipt to the Member.
goal: Wire the return flow between Member, 1.0 Process Return, and both data stores so policy lookup, loan update, and receipt delivery are modeled accurately.
learningObjective: Model a process that simultaneously reads from one Data Store and writes to another.
hints: D2 Policies is read by the process, whereas D1 Loans is updated by the process.
Remember that Member both initiates the return and receives a receipt back from 1.0 Process Return.
Connect Member -> 1.0 Process Return, D2 Policies -> 1.0 Process Return, 1.0 Process Return -> D1 Loans, and 1.0 Process Return -> Member.
solutionExplanation: Member submits the book to 1.0 Process Return, which reads D2 Policies, writes the updated status to D1 Loans, and returns a receipt to Member.

solutions.description: Policy read, loan update, and member receipt data flows
